summary: Cenntro Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of up to 12.8 million common shares at $3.773 per share, priced at the five-day VWAP, for gross proceeds of about $48.3 million, to accredited non-U.S. investors under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S. Proceeds fund working capital. The placement relies on Nasdaq Rule 5635(d) for pricing above minimum price, avoiding shareholder approval. Closing conditions are unmet; no shares issued yet. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation, with no change of control or strategic event. Watch for closing and share issuance overhang.
